info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Limits Management API
info.description: The Credit Limits Management API allows financial institutions to efficiently adjust and manage credit limits for customers. Through the PATCH operation, users can update existing credit limits based on specific business rules or customer requirements. This API is primarily utilized by banking applications and support teams to maintain accurate credit information, ensuring compliance and risk management. Applications integrating this API will streamline credit allocation processes, enhance customer service, and improve decision-making capabilities.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the credit limit for a specific resource identified by its ID. It is essential for managing credit allocation effectively within trade banking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the credit limit for a specific trading account identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. The body should contain the necessary details including the new credit limit and any other associated metadata that is required to process this update.

200.description: The request was successful and the credit limit has been updated.
